title:
BANK
aapse kaise kamata hai?
clips: Bank ki nazar mein <y>sabse 'bekaar'</y> customer… shayad <r>aap</r> ho?
Bill <y>time pe</y> bharte ho? Toh bank aapse <y>₹0</y> kamata hai… <r>right?</r>
<r>Galat!</r> Chalo, jaante hain… bank <y>kaise kamata hai?</y>
Har swipe pe dukaandaar bank ko <y>~2%</y> deta hai…
Ye ~2% baant lete hain: <y>aapka bank</y>, <y>card network</y> aur <y>dukaan ka bank</y>
₹1,000 ke swipe pe <y>~₹20</y> seedha bank ki tijori mein
Research kehti hai: card se log <y>cash se zyada</y> kharch karte hain
Phir aata hai <y>annual fee</y>… upar se <r>18% GST</r>
Card se cash nikala? <r>~2.5% fee</r> + <r>pehle din se interest</r>
Points <r>expire</r> hue? Wo bhi <y>bank ka profit</y>
"Sir, <y>card protection plan</y> le lo…" aur ek <r>extra charge</r> shuru
Sirf <r>minimum due</r> bhara? Time pe bhi… <r>~40%</r> saal ka interest
<y>Co-brand cards:</y> bank aur brands milke aapke kharch se kamaate hain
Matlab bank <y>har taraf</y> se kama raha hai…
Ab card ko <y>apne liye</y> kaam karwao

Aapka bank aapse kitna kamata hai?
Comment karo ↓
disclaimer: Fees approx. hain, bank aur card ke hisaab se alag ho sakti hain. Educational only.
